rows.grounds: compound of great, king, and sequence; nominative singular masculine
passive present third singular of kath

items.question: What great-king-sequence is now being revealed to the goddess?
premises: The speaker addresses the goddess directly.
The great-king-sequence is being told now.
The listener is urged to hear it.
items.inference: The verse announces the immediate revelation of the great-king-sequence to the goddess.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal referent of mahārājakrama is not specified in this verse.
sāmpratam functions as a temporal adverb rather than a technical term.
items.plain_english: O goddess, the great-king-sequence is now being told; listen.
